_comment: KEY HYGIENE 2026-08-06: pitfall_index moved 0 -> 90 (the documented >=90 sentinel convention, in use on all nine backends) because this fixture and iga_surface_condition_naming both fell back to kratos::iga::0 and a shared runner key marks BOTH results failed. iga_surface_condition_naming keeps index 0 as the owner of that claim; this one probes the same registry facts from the other side and now reports under its own key. Nothing about what the fixture runs or expects changed. --- Tier-2: 'SurfaceLoadCondition' (bare) is not registered; the suffixed SurfaceLoadCondition3D3N/3D4N come from StructuralMechanicsApplication, and IGA's own surface-integration condition is SurfaceCondition3D3N (no 'Load'). Pitfall (kratos.iga #0). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The bare name raises RuntimeError 'The Condition "SurfaceLoadCondition" is not registered!'; all three suffixed spellings construct. Complements the existing iga_surface_condition_naming fixture by pinning the Load-vs-no-Load distinction the claim also makes. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
